description: This file customizes and extends jQuery UI dialog widget by adding default styling classes, managing focus behavior, and accessibility features.

classes.name: ui.dialog
classes.description: Extended jQuery UI dialog widget with custom button classes, focus management, and accessibility enhancements.

methods.name: _createButtons
methods.description: Creates dialog buttons with default and primary classes, handling primary button designation.

methods.name: _createWrapper
methods.description: Initializes dialog DOM structure, sets accessibility attributes, and binds event handlers for keyboard and mouse interactions.

methods.name: _focusTabbable
methods.description: Overrides default focus behavior to use core/tabbable library for finding focusable elements within the dialog.
